notes.title: Release postponed!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33913856/69bd6828725276093982032a6d54781940ac9c18.png

Unfortunately, our game must be shifted from private circumstances on an uncertain time! Is planned  in the end of 2021 till 2022 .

Besides we will publish all bigger contents in separate enlargements here on Steam. For us a difficult step, indeed, for you a big advantage: You can uninstall useless elements from the game.

In next weeks we want to create a application form. There you could apply for our beta testing. 

We apologize for the inconvenience.
